# `<e-badge-count>`

<p><img alt="e-badge-count screenshot" src="__tests__/__screenshots__/primitives-badgecount--dotonly.png" width="480" /></p>

Numeric or dot indicator overlaid on a child element.

Wraps its children and decorates them with a count chip in the corner.

> Source: [badge-count.ts](./badge-count.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | `0` | Numeric value to display. `0` hides the indicator unless `dot` is set. |
| `max` | `number` | `99` | Upper bound; values above render as `<max>+`. |
| `dot` | `boolean` | — | Show a small dot instead of the numeric chip. |
